messages:
Lee (Support): FYI incoming from Acme Health — they want a single blended per-token price when they commit to reserved capacity + occasional overage credits. They also asked if credits can roll over each month. Need product wording for sales asap.
Maya (Sales): +1, deal is ~$250k commit/year if we can do blended pricing + 2 months of burst credits. They want simple contractual language. Can product outline acceptable options? :wave:
Alex (Product): Quick triage: we need use-case details (peak qps, avg seq len, embedding vs gen mix), customer tolerance for SLO breaches, and whether they require data residency. For pricing options we should propose 3 tiers: commit-only, commit+burst credits, and blended-commit (formula).
Sam (Finance): Heads-up — blended math usually reduces short-term revenue predictability. If we do blended, require earnings floor (min monthly spend) or cap blended discount to X%. Also need overage uplift (e.g., 1.5x commit rate) to protect margin.
Jordan (Eng): From infra side: burst credits map to capacity reservations + soft quota. If they want guaranteed burst beyond commit, that's a Dedicated capacity ask (reservation). For hosted, we can support transient burst but must enforce throttles.
Tess (Pricing): Draft language suggestion for sales: "We offer a blended effective rate when combining committed tokens with your burst credits. The effective per-token rate is calculated monthly as: \n```\neffective_rate = (committed_tokens * committed_rate + overage_tokens * overage_rate) / (committed_tokens + overage_tokens)\n```\nOverage rate = 150% of committed_rate by default. Credits expire after 90 days unless explicitly contracted. Rollover only available with annual commitment.
Maya (Sales): That formula is great, can we make rollover 2 months for pilot deals? Acme specifically asked for 60-day rollover.
Alex (Product): We can offer a limited pilot concession: one-time 60-day rollover for pilot customers under $500k ARR with product approval. Launch criteria: product sign-off on billing logic, ENG confirms quota enforcement, Finance approves revenue recognition language, legal signs off on contract clause.
Sam (Finance): Approved with conditions: mark pilot as 'promo' in ERP, no revenue deferral changes, patch billing SKU for blended so we can track.
Jordan (Eng): Implementation notes for eng: add new billing flag `blended_pricing:true`, enforce overage rate multiplier at billing time, and server-side quota check for burst credits. Might need 2 sprints for safe rollout.
triage-bot: Tagged: intake/pricing, priority:high
Lee (Support): I'll capture customer answers re: token mix + sequence length and post here later.
Maya (Sales): If product approves the pilot concession, I'll propose it to Acme today. Please respond by EOD. :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): Agreed. Action items: 1) Lee: collect workload metrics from Acme. 2) Jordan: estimate implementation ETA (sprint count). 3) Tess + Sam: finalize pilot wording + margin cap. 4) Alex: I'll prepare PRD + acceptance criteria.
Tess (Pricing): One more suggestion: name the offering "Commit + Burst Pilot" in contract to make tracking easier.
Maya (Sales): Nice. I'll push that naming.
Sam (Finance): Put a finance tag on the contract: FIN-PIPELINE-ACME.
Alex (Product): Thanks — will draft PRD and link here. If anyone has objections to the 150% overage uplift or 90-day expiry, call it out now.
Jordan (Eng): No objection from eng, just the timeline caveat.
Lee (Support): FYI Acme provided sample traffic: avg seq 512 tokens, embeddings 10% of calls, peaks at 4x baseline. Posting raw logs in the support ticket.
Maya (Sales): Perfect, that helps. I'm going to propose the pilot.
Alex (Product): Great. We'll reconvene after Lee posts metrics. Thanks all.
